subject: english
title: Еда и напитки
summary: 20 слов о еде: bread, water, tea, meat, apple, eat, drink, breakfast…
theory:
## Как учить эти слова
Еда — самая «живая» тема: ты видишь эти вещи каждый день, поэтому слова запоминаются быстро.

1. **15 новых слов в день** — не больше. Остальное время — повторение по карточкам.
2. **Говори вслух**: слово, транскрипция и пример — по 3 раза.
3. **Пиши свои предложения**: 5 фраз о том, что ты ешь (*I have tea and bread for breakfast.*).
4. **Называй вещи по-английски**: за столом мысленно называй всё, что видишь. И лови эти слова в Extra English.

## Совет: a / an и слова без a
Перед тем, что можно посчитать, ставим *a*, а перед гласным звуком — *an*: **an** apple, **an** egg, **a** banana.

Но некоторые слова не считаются поштучно: *water, milk, tea, coffee, bread, rice, sugar, meat*. С ними **нет** *a*, и нет *-s*. Говорим так: *some water*, *a glass of milk*, *a cup of tea*, *a piece of bread*.

Ещё: с завтраком, обедом и ужином нужен глагол *have* и нет *the*: **have breakfast**, **have lunch**, **have dinner**.

words.def: things that people and animals eat
words.example: I like Kazakh food.

words.def: the clear drink with no taste that we need to live
words.example: Can I have a glass of water, please?

words.def: a hot drink made with dry leaves and water
words.example: In Kazakhstan people drink tea with milk.

words.def: a hot brown drink; many people drink it in the morning
words.example: My father drinks coffee every morning.

words.def: the white drink that comes from cows
words.example: I have milk and bread for breakfast.

words.def: a common food; we buy it in a shop and make sandwiches with it
words.example: Please buy some bread on the way home.

words.def: food from animals, like beef or chicken
words.example: We often eat meat for dinner.

words.def: a bird that people keep for eggs and meat; also its meat
words.example: I want chicken and rice, please.

words.def: an animal that lives in water; also its meat as food
words.example: My mum cooks fish on Fridays.

words.def: a round white thing from a chicken; we cook and eat it
words.example: I eat two eggs for breakfast.

words.def: a round red or green fruit that grows on a tree
words.example: Almaty has very good apples.

words.def: sweet food from a plant or tree, like an apple or a banana
words.example: I eat fruit every day.

words.def: a plant we eat, like a potato, a carrot or a tomato
words.example: My grandmother grows vegetables in her garden.

words.def: small white grains that we cook and eat, for example in plov
words.example: We cook plov with rice, meat and carrots.

words.def: a sweet white thing we put in tea or coffee
words.example: I don't put sugar in my tea.

words.def: the first meal of the day, in the morning
words.example: I have breakfast at seven.

words.def: the meal we eat in the middle of the day
words.example: We have lunch at school at one o'clock.

words.def: the main meal of the day, in the evening
words.example: My family has dinner together at eight.

words.def: to put food in your mouth and have it
words.example: I usually eat at home.

words.def: to take water, tea, milk or juice into your mouth
words.example: I drink a lot of water in summer.

questions.explanation: Bread — хлеб. Meat — мясо, rice — рис, milk — молоко.
Breakfast — завтрак, lunch — обед, dinner — ужин, food — еда вообще.
Vegetable — овощ, vegetables — овощи (картошка, морковь). Fruit — фрукты.
Egg — яйцо. Apple — яблоко, fish — рыба, sugar — сахар.

questions.text: Выберите слово, подходящее в предложение: I have ___ at 7 in the morning.
questions.explanation: В 7 утра едят завтрак — *have breakfast*. Dinner — вечером, lunch — днём.

questions.text: Выберите слово, подходящее в предложение: Can I have a glass of ___, please?
questions.explanation: *A glass of water* — стакан воды. В стакане бывает только напиток.
Chicken — курица и куриное мясо. Fish — рыба, meat — мясо вообще, egg — яйцо.

questions.text: Выберите слово, подходящее в предложение: I want ___ apple.
questions.explanation: Apple начинается с гласного звука, поэтому **an** apple. *A* ставим перед согласным: *a banana*.
Drink — пить (*drink tea*). Eat — есть, cook — готовить, make — делать.

questions.text: Выберите слово, подходящее в предложение: My mum puts ___ in her tea, so it is sweet.
questions.explanation: Sugar — сахар, он делает чай сладким (sweet).
